Faucet and fixture replacement done right

Whether a fixture is leaking, worn out or just out of style, replacing it is one of the simplest upgrades you can make.

We replace and install faucets, sinks, toilets and shower fixtures, along with the drains, supply lines and valves that go with them. When we are done, we clean up.

What we handle

  • Kitchen and bathroom faucets
  • Sinks and sink drains
  • Toilets
  • Showerheads and tub fixtures
  • Supply lines and shutoff valves

Good reasons to replace a fixture

  • Constant dripping or leaking
  • Low flow at one fixture
  • Cracks, rust or corrosion
  • Updating the look of a kitchen or bath

Replacing an old fixture often fixes the leak and the look at the same time.

Questions about faucet and fixture replacement

Do you replace the drain under the sink too?

Yes. If the drain or trap under the sink is old or leaking, we can replace it at the same time.

Do you install toilets?

Yes. We replace and install toilets, along with the supply line and shutoff valve.

Do you give free estimates?

Yes. Estimates are free within San Antonio city limits.

What are your hours?

We are open Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm. Weekends are for scheduled and emergency work. We are not a 24 hour service.
